# Linux v1 plan fixtures

Verbatim extracts of the five test-referenced files from
`release-planning/linux-v1/` (issue #2477, mechanical half):

- `licenses.md`
- `feature-matrix.md`
- `companion-contracts.md`
- `safety-evaluation.md`
- `pyinstaller-warning-dispositions-attempt4.json`

Tests read these fixtures, not the plan tree. The plan tree itself is
retained (legal drafts under `release-planning/linux-v1/legal/` remain
under owner/counsel retention review; no archive in this change). If a
plan source changes, re-extract the corresponding fixture verbatim and
re-run the referencing tests.
